messages.subject: Rescale in writeWave not working
parts:
Hi!

I have a curious problem  and I am sure this has worked before, but I can't figure it out.

I am downmixing/sampling a 44k stereo file to 22k mono and want to export it after, but I don't want to normalise it. 

Jerome had recommended me the rescale trick - just rescale it by its old range. However I am getting 

Error in writeWave(resampled, soundfile, rescale = range(resampled@left)) : 
  unused argument (rescale = range(resampled@left))

Code is below and file is attached! Any pointers?

Simon
------------------------------------------
    soundfile<-("test_rs01_20080430_143000.wav")
    full<-readWave(soundfile)
    mix<-0.5*full@left+0.5*full@right
    resampled<-resamp(mix,f=detectsamplerate$sample.rate,g=22050, output="Wave")
    writeWave(resampled, soundfile, rescale=range(resampled@left))

messages.author: 65c82d09eac308cf
messages.subject: Re: [seewave] Rescale in writeWave not working
parts:
Hi Simon,
The argument 'rescale' is for the function savewav() of seewave, not for writeWave() of tuneR.
So try:
savewav(resampled, f=22050, filename=soundfile, rescale=range(resampled@left)
HTH
Jerome

messages.author: 9548a6e564997481
messages.subject: Re: [seewave] Rescale in writeWave not working
parts:
Hi Simon,

Ben is right, you are not normalizing. But yes it is either save wav with the 'rescale' argument or writeWave without anything else. Here is a working example with both (except save wav apparently centers max and min around 0, so I'd recommend writeWav):

------------------------
library(seewave)
library(tuneR)

data(tico)
range(tico@left)

tico.resamp <- resamp(tico, f=ti...@samp.rate,g=11025, output="Wave")

range(tico.resamp@left)

writeWave(tico.resamp, filename = 'tico-resamp.wav')

tico.read <- readWave('tico-resamp.wav')
range(tico.read@left)

savewav(tico.resamp, filename = 'tico-resamp-save.wav', rescale=range(tico.resamp@left))
tico.read2 <- readWave('tico-resamp-save.wav')
range(tico.read2@left)
------------------------------------------

Cheers,
Camille
